_note: The deployed generation on VinuChain mainnet, recorded from the chain and the explorer rather than from this repository's source — the source is strictly NEWER than what is live. This file is a record, not configuration: nothing imports it at runtime. It is verified by 'yarn verify:deployment' (scripts/verify-deployment-record.mjs) and consumed by test/deployment.rehearsal.test.ts, which rehearses the real deploy scripts with these arguments.
carriedFaults: The Marketplace commission account IS the deployer and the owner (0x12BD0b15D5010De455DCe7944265Fe1D35a84023), which AGENTS.md 'Production deployment rule' forbids. It is fixable on the live contract only by an owner-only setCommissionAccount call — an operator action, not a source change. scripts/deploy_marketplace.ts now refuses this configuration for the next generation.

v1 buyToken is payable and the contract declares no receive, fallback, withdraw or rescue function, so native VC sent to it is unrecoverable by anyone. Observed balance is 0 wei and no product path sends value (src/components/BuyButton.js passes no overrides object). The next generation rejects value; test/marketplace.nativevalue.test.ts holds it to that.

The deployed generation predates ERC1155Supply's zero-argument totalSupply() and predates MAX_AMOUNT / MAX_PLATFORM_FEE_PERCENTAGE. Regenerating the frontend ABIs from current artifacts therefore changes behaviour; see docs/migration-and-rollback.md.
